Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Trip and medical-travel coordination owns itinerary, destination/accessibility and provider comparison views. This resolves 778: country/city/cost/reviews are travel-planning context, while actual provider identity stays CAP-IDENTITY and success-rate definitions stay CAP-RESEARCH. Preserve clinic/dentist selection, accessible airports/hotels/pharmacies/hospitals, equipment rental, medicine/visa/insurance and advisory references. Success rates require source/cohort/denominator/time and missingness before comparison; no ranking, treatment eligibility or outcome guarantee is inferred. Shared-profile/contact/QR flags record intent, not grants. Current country rules require authoritative version/date evidence; historical source examples are not current advice.

reviews.title: Cross-Border Medical Record Exchange
reviews.body:
# Cross-Border Medical Record Exchange

Purpose

Secure exchange of medical records between healthcare organizations in different countries.

Supports

• Patient Consent

• Secure Transfer

• Audit Trail

• Standardized Formats

• Encrypted Communication

• Automatic Translation

Designed for international continuity of care.

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Generic and pediatric renal international exchange share transport/mapping ownership despite legacy AI titles. Preserve consent/purpose, patient matching, standardized records, imaging/labs/pathology, medication/dialysis/transplant context, source freshness, translation and receiver handover. Translation is an attributed derivative; cross-border transfer requires actual partner/jurisdiction contracts and cannot expand emergency access or overwrite source facts.

reviews.title: Medication Travel Certificate
reviews.body:
# Medication Travel Certificate

Generates travel documentation for prescribed medications.

Supports

• Physician Information

• Medication List

• Diagnosis

• QR Verification

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Medication travel certificate is a versioned document derivative linking qualified physician, prescribed medication and diagnosis source where authorized, with scoped QR verification. A generated certificate does not certify authenticity, medication legality, border acceptance or prescribing authority. Minimize diagnosis disclosure and preserve signature/issuer provenance.

reviews.verdict: Pre-travel and imported-infection care retain destination/duration/dates, history, vaccination/prevention, malaria/food/water/vector/animal exposure, illness/symptoms/labs and follow-up. WHO/national/international guidance intent needs an exact approved source release; the registry does not provide validated prophylactic doses, required vaccines or individual travel clearance.

reviews.title: Cross-Border Immunization Migration Engine
reviews.body:
Recalculates vaccination requirements after international relocation.

Example

Estonia
↓
Germany

System compares

• Previous Vaccinations
• Antigen Composition
• Dose Numbers
• Product Equivalence
• German Schedule
• Age Requirements
• Catch-up Requirements

Preserves the original vaccination history.

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Product names/history, antigen components, dose sequences, national schedules, age/catch-up and transit/date/duration form explicit reconciliation profiles. Preserve original vaccination history and uncertain equivalence, never silently recompute it as fact. Schedule/requirement versions and jurisdiction applicability need qualified confirmation; Estonia/Germany is a historical example, not a current validated schedule.
